meta.prompt_example:
Can you give me a program representing the schema for a concept? For example,
gen(concept=academia) =
gen(campus | concept=academia)
gen(faculty | concept=academia, campus)
gen(students | concept=academia, campus)
gen(courses | concept=academia, faculty, students)
gen(degrees | concept=academia, students, courses)
gen(funding | concept=academia, faculty)
gen(research-output | concept=academia, faculty, students, funding)
gen(publications | concept=academia, research-output)
gen(conferences | concept=academia, publications)
Please do the same for gen(concept=<concept>) in the same format without explanation. Keep the program simple with ten or less components. Use only the most necessary parts of the schema that can be mapped to objects in an image.
